quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his first NBA start and team performance
quotes.excerpt: It was definitely a good opportunity for me and the guys to showcase, but we didn't get the outcome we wanted.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What was the reality of your first NBA start field based on the anticipation of it earlier today?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: It felt pretty good, especially to get out there. It was definitely a good opportunity for me and the guys to showcase, but we didn't get the outcome we wanted. We just have to get better from that.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries on his first NBA start: It felt pretty good to get out there. It was a good opportunity to showcase what we can do, but we did not get the outcome we wanted. We just have to get better from that.

structured.context: Brayden Burries reflects on his first NBA start and the team's performance following a loss.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on the importance of rebounding to his game
quotes.excerpt: Rebounding is something that gives me more juice on the floor than anything.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: The way that you're impacting the game on the boards, I know after your game the other day you said that rebounding is something that gives you more juice on the floor than anything. So when you can have nine rebounds in the game, what does that mean to you?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: Finding other ways to impact the game of winning outside of scoring. The shot wasn't falling today, it happens, it's natural. I'm just trying to figure out how to impact the game, rebounding, finding guys open, other ways to especially rebound. Rebounding gets me going, so I just try to find myself to rebound and put myself in position to be successful.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries on his rebounding focus: Rebounding gets me going. I am just trying to figure out how to impact the game of winning outside of scoring. When the shot is not falling, I try to put myself in position to be successful.

structured.context: Brayden Burries discusses his focus on rebounding and finding ways to impact the game when his shot is not falling.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on team consistency and playing full 48 minutes
quotes.excerpt: I think we just go in spurts of droughts where we can't really seem to get a little flow.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: A full 48 minutes is still something you guys are searching for. What do you feel like is still holding this group back from 48 minutes?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: I think we just go in spurts of droughts where we can't really seem to get a little flow. Defensively, they got a lot of offensive rebounds, so we just got to get better, especially me included. We're getting open looks, but it just wasn't going in tonight.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries says the Bucks are still searching for a full 48 minutes of consistency. He notes the team goes in spurts of droughts where they cannot seem to get a flow and need to improve defensively on the glass.

structured.context: Brayden Burries addresses the team's struggle to maintain consistency and defensive rebounding throughout a full game.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on staying the course despite fourth quarter struggles
quotes.excerpt: The fourth quarter they went on a good run. They broke it from three to 10.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: The coach's message to you guys a lot tonight was stay the course. How do you feel like you guys were able to stay the course through much of this game?

text_blocks.speaker: Brayden Burries
text_blocks.text: I think we did a pretty good job, just not good enough. I think the fourth quarter they went on a good run. They broke it from three to 10 and then we couldn't really find our self back to even and getting the lead. We just got to get better in those areas.

quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries on the fourth quarter struggles against the opponent: They broke it from three to 10 and we could not really find ourselves back to even. We just have to get better in those areas.

structured.context: Brayden Burries discusses the team's inability to overcome a fourth-quarter run by the opponent.
